initiatives.name: Environmental Performance Improvement Program
initiatives.summary: Severn Trent delivered significant environmental improvements including 41% reduction in average spills through over 3,000 CSO interventions and 35% reduction in pollutions by upgrading 75 sewage pumping stations. The company installed 9,000 new sensors at high-risk pollution locations.

initiatives.name: Major Capital Investment Program
initiatives.summary: Severn Trent invested £1.9bn in capital investment during FY26, representing a 16.7% increase from the previous year. This investment drove 13% regulatory asset base growth and covered asset upgrades, environmental improvements, resilience, and regulatory compliance across over 2,000 projects.

initiatives.name: Cost Efficiency and Operating Model Transformation
initiatives.summary: The company is targeting £150m total operating cost efficiencies by 2030 and has locked in around 40% of its £500m capital efficiency target. This includes vertically integrated capabilities, direct procurement, value engineering, and standardization approaches.

initiatives.name: Reopener Submission Infrastructure Investment
initiatives.summary: Severn Trent submitted a £588m reopener proposal covering critical infrastructure investments including upgrading boreholes, renewing water storage tanks, increasing sewage capacity, and sewer resilience improvements. The submission represents strategic investment in growth and asset resilience.

initiatives.name: Digital and Standardization Initiative
initiatives.summary: The company is implementing 'Plug and Play' standardization and modular systems based on motor industry approach, along with smart solutions for projects under £10m. This digital transformation supports the capital efficiency targets and operational improvements.

initiatives.name: AI-Driven Operational Enhancement Program with Kraken
initiatives.summary: Severn Trent is leveraging AI across multiple operational areas including capital investment optimization, asset optimization for predictive maintenance, sewer inflow detection, customer service through Kraken platform, and extreme weather risk management. The AI initiatives are designed to reduce costs, improve customer outcomes, and enhance environmental performance.

initiatives.name: Vertical Integration and Insourcing Strategy
initiatives.summary: Severn Trent is building vertically integrated and insourced capabilities for its regulated business to maintain control and flexibility while reducing programme delivery risk. This represents a strategic shift in operational delivery model.
